name: @comet/ui
description: Shared internal code for the AltaVue platform — the field-level tooltip help system and the comments and @mentions components (root entry), plus three entry points that load nothing else: @comet/ui/help (the tooltip help system alone), @comet/ui/dates (calendar days and moments, AO-2012) and @comet/ui/finance (contract value and margin wording, AO-1999).

scripts.test: tsx src/comments/doc.test.ts && tsx src/dates/dates.test.ts && tsx src/finance/finance.test.ts
